critical_analysis.long_bias_warning: N=10 with 12 stocks = 10L/2S (83% long). Not market neutral. Captures bull market beta.
critical_analysis.regime_filter_ineffective: UFT>0.65 regime gate eliminates almost all 12 stocks (avg 0.2 pass). Code falls back to all stocks. Regime filter is meaningless with this universe size.
critical_analysis.train_test_stability: Best N=3 config: train Sharpe=0.220, test Sharpe=1.715 (7.8x jump). Strong concern for overfitting or regime-specific alpha.
critical_analysis.paper_vs_reality: Paper uses 500+ stocks with meaningful cross-sectional dispersion. 12 stocks is too small for regime-conditional factors to work as designed.

best_genuine_config.note: N=3, regime_mode=none, weekly rebal, VW=0.8/0.2, RL=20 — closest to market-neutral
best_genuine_config.concern: Low train Sharpe suggests this may be test-period-specific luck

median_results.interpretation: Only N=10 has positive median (long bias). N=3 and N=5 median negative = strategy loses money most of the time.

critical_analysis.recommendation: Expand universe to 50-100+ stocks before drawing conclusions. Current 12-stock universe cannot properly test the paper methodology.
